title: Beyond Content: A Comprehensive Speech Toxicity Dataset and Detection Framework Incorporating Paralinguistic Cues

layout.note: Dataset Collection is a tall lavender column at the left; next to it a column of three tinted boxes (multimodal filtering, label extraction, hybrid verification) runs top-down; a narrower right column holds the synthetic pipeline (text generation, speech synthesis). Hybrid Verification stretches under both pipelines as a shared band. Dash-dot header lines carry the two pipeline titles.

lesson: Show each stage of an annotation pipeline as a tinted box that holds its own prompt card and a sample answer, and keep two model paths apart by colour until they meet in a shared verification box.
